evidence.dominant_driver: CNBC survey says 89% expect BOJ to hike 25bp to 1.25% on Friday, reinforcing an already strongly priced tightening consensus.

market_expectations.distribution_notes: Reuters poll six days earlier also showed an overwhelming September-hike consensus, so this is confirmation rather than a new regime shift.

absorption.reason: The hike expectation was already widely priced before the CNBC survey; by decision time the story was over two hours old.

observed_reaction.NI225: around -0.2% at 63,359 in fresh Asian reporting
observed_reaction.USDJPY: around 155.22, yen slightly weaker rather than stronger

observations.USDJPY: ~155.22, yen weaker, not confirming a fresh hawkish yen impulse
observations.JGB10Y: ~3.035%, elevated and consistent with tightening expectations
observations.US10Y: ~4.9875% in Asian trade after briefly topping 5%, global valuation headwind
observations.VIX: 17.2 prior close, cautious but not stressed

evidence.decision_notes: Forecast is strictly residual from 03:40 UTC; no attempt to forecast the original 01:18 UTC reaction. M2 learning profile has no ACTIONABLE model-2 segment applicable enough to change confidence; EARLY_SIGNAL ignored for material adjustment.

US2Y.source: fresh market reports; no reliable exact quote captured

immediate.rationale: The survey mostly confirms an already-priced hike; yen action does not confirm a fresh hawkish shock.

next_session.rationale: Fed first and BOJ guidance later can dominate the already-priced hike expectation.

15m.rationale: Story is delayed and largely priced; no clean residual directional edge.

1h.rationale: High JGB/US yields are negative, but weaker yen cushions exporters.

4h.rationale: Pre-Fed positioning and oil/yield moves can overwhelm this survey confirmation.

next_session.rationale: Fed outcome plus BOJ meeting positioning creates two-sided gap/volatility risk.

predictions.mechanism: BOJ tightening expectations raise domestic discount rates and can strengthen JPY, but the survey is confirmation of a consensus already in price.
predictions.invalidation: A decisive yen strengthening move together with rising JGB yields and broad Nikkei selling would convert the residual view bearish.
predictions.counter_case: If USD/JPY falls sharply while JGB yields rise and exporters weaken, the already-priced assumption is wrong and NI225 can sell off directionally.

technical_state.source: WSJ fresh Asian market report: Nikkei about -0.2% at 63,359.03
